描述_EN: the popular tekno (also marketed as "teksta") robotic puppy was manufactured by manley toy quest in may 2000, as a cheaper alternative to other robotic animals available at the time. it was programmed with a puppy's 'intelligence' and as such it required feeding and walking. it could also do tricks and learn some basic spoken words, as well as many other functions.
描述_ZN: 流行的Tekno（也被称为 "Teksta"）机器人小狗是由Manley Toy Quest在2000年5月制造的，作为当时其他机器人动物的便宜替代品。 它被编程为具有小狗的 "智力"，因此它需要喂食和行走。 它也可以做一些小把戏，学习一些基本的口语，以及许多其他功能。
